key.name: toggle-popup
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the popup

key.name: super-key-opens-popup
key.summary: Open the popup with the Super key instead of the overview
key.description: Pressing Super twice quickly opens the overview. The Activities button and hot corner still open the overview.

key.name: backdrop-transparency
key.summary: Transparency of the backdrop behind the popup, in percent

key.name: dash-at-bottom
key.summary: Show the dash at the bottom of the screen
key.description: Instead of attached below the search panel.

key.name: enable-path-search
key.description: Search text starting with /, ~ or file:// offers to open the path or show it in Files, suggests matching entries, and completes with Tab.

key.name: enable-run-command
key.description: Search text starting with “run ” offers to run the rest as a command. Failures are shown as a notification.
